description: This file defines a PHP class for the ADOdb library's PostgreSQL 6.4 driver, including database connection management, metadata retrieval, query execution, transaction control, blob handling, and other database operations specific to PostgreSQL 6.4 environment.

classes.name: ADODB_postgres64
classes.description: PHP class implementing a PostgreSQL 6.4 driver for ADOdb, managing connection, query execution, metadata, transactions, and blob handling tailored to PostgreSQL 6.4.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_postgres64
classes.description: PHP class extending ADORecordSet for handling PostgreSQL 6.4 recordsets, including blob data decoding and record navigation.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves server information such as version, description, and client info.

methods.name: IfNull
methods.description: Returns COALESCE SQL expression to handle null values.

methods.name: pg_insert_id
methods.description: Deprecated method to get last inserted ID based on sequence.

methods.name: _insertID
methods.description: Gets last OID or ID after insert operation.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns number of rows affected by last query.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Starts a database transaction.

methods.name: CommitTrans
methods.description: Commits current transaction.

methods.name: RollbackTrans
methods.description: Rolls back current transaction.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves list of tables and views, with optional filtering.

methods.name: qStr
methods.description: Quotes a string for safe SQL inclusion using pg_escape_string.

methods.name: SQLDate
methods.description: Generates SQL for date formatting using TO_CHAR.

methods.name: UpdateBlobFile
methods.description: Stores a file as a large object in the database and updates a blob field with its OID.

methods.name: BlobDelete
methods.description: Deletes a blob object from the database.

methods.name: GuessOID
methods.description: Heuristically checks if a given value is an OID.

methods.name: BlobDecode
methods.description: Reads and decodes a blob from the database.

methods.name: BlobEncode
methods.description: Encodes binary data for database storage.

methods.name: UpdateBlob
methods.description: Updates a blob column with binary data.

methods.name: OffsetDate
methods.description: Returns a date expression offset by the specified days.

methods.name: _generateMetaColumnsSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL for retrieving column metadata.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about table columns, including types, defaults, and keys.

methods.name: param
methods.description: Generates parameter placeholders for parameterized queries.

methods.name: MetaIndexes
methods.description: Retrieves index information for a table.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a database connection using connection string or host/port details.

methods.name: _nconnect
methods.description: Establishes a non-persistent connection to the database.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Establishes a persistent connection to the database.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes SQL queries, with support for prepared statements.

methods.name: _errconnect
methods.description: Returns error code/message on connection failure.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns the last database error message.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Returns the last error code.

methods.name: _close
methods.description: Closes the database connection and frees resources.

methods.name: CharMax
methods.description: Returns maximum size for character fields.

methods.name: TextMax
methods.description: Returns maximum size for text fields.
